title: Labels
description: Card labels are set only by verify/. Ladder: CONJECTURE<REPRODUCED<DIFFERS<ROBUST<{KNOWN-MECHANISM|NOVEL-CANDIDATE}. Any card label above CONJECTURE requires gate (checker, signature) on the card. Agents cannot self-promote. FAILED, DEAD-END, INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION are terminal and kept; they are not promotions and do not require gate.
